msg: When deciding on which mushroom character to choose, try choosing the lighter mushroom first and then the darker mushroom. If the lighter coloured mushroom gives you more mushrooms than the darker one, then keep choosing that one until it starts giving you mushrooms that less than 4.  Once this happens, then choose the other mushroom (i.e. if you were choosing the lighter coloured mushroom then choose the darker one) and this will help to increase your mushroom count.  NOTE: Remember to press the space bar otherwise you could lose potential mushrooms towards your score.
